title: Endorsement Manual: Owner Auto Policy Vehicle Additions and Removals
content:
**Additional vehicles.** Coverage for an added vehicle on an Owner Auto Policy starts on the date the vehicle was acquired only when the vehicle is reported no later than the additional-vehicle reporting days after it was acquired.
- Calendar days are counted from the acquisition date as day 0.
- A report on or before the acquisition date plus the reporting days qualifies.
- The acquisition date is read from the vehicle's recorded acquisition date on the change.

**Replacement vehicles.** A replacement vehicle reported within the replacement-vehicle reporting days of acquisition also starts on its acquisition date. Any later report starts on the report date. Both reporting windows are in the mid-term change terms.

**Vehicle limit.** Vehicles on the term may not exceed the package's maximum vehicles.

**Removals.** A vehicle is removed on the date requested, never earlier than the request date.

**Premium.** Additional and return premium are the vehicle's full-term premium share, prorated from the change effective date over the term's days.

**Boundary cases (hypothetical, 14-day additional-vehicle window).**

| Acquired | Reported | Coverage starts |
|---|---|---|
| the 3rd | the 17th (day 14) | the 3rd |
| the 3rd | the 18th (day 15) | not from acquisition |
